c scan

The 'CScan' function in the OP billing service is specifically designed to scan cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. Users can access this feature by clicking the 'CScan' button from the OP service billing screen. To utilize the CScan, the user must enter a file number, which can be done manually by typing in digits (excluding zero) and pressing the enter key, allowing the system to automatically fill in the remaining characters. This functionality is part of a broader system that allows for the management of patient documents and billing processes, ensuring that all necessary patient information is accurately captured and processed.

![CScan op billing service](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114401.png)

VScan

The VScan is a form used in the OP billing service to view the scanned documents of patients. It can be accessed by clicking the 'VScan' button from the OP service billing screen. By entering the patient's file number, users can view the attached documents, and by clicking on specific document categories, the relevant documents will be displayed.

![VScan Form](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114308.png)

Referral- Patient Document Scan

The 'Referral - Patient Document Scan' form is utilized to scan documents related to the patient. This form can be accessed by clicking the 'Referral' button from the OP service billing screen. Additionally, documents submitted by patients can be added by clicking the 'Scan' button. This process allows for the inclusion of referral letters and other necessary documentation associated with the patient's visit.

![Referral Patient Document Scan](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114243.png)

Eligibility Discovery

The Eligibility Discovery form is utilized to check a patient's eligibility for billing services under an insurance company. It allows users to view patient details, available coverage, and benefits. If a patient is found to be ineligible for billing services, a pop-up message will appear on the form to notify the user. This functionality can be accessed by clicking the 'Elig. Discovery' button from the OP service billing screen, which will display the eligibility status along with the relevant coverage and benefits information.

![Eligibility Discovery Form](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113553.png)

op billing service advanced

The OP Billing Service Advanced is a module designed for managing the billing process for outpatient services in a hospital. It serves as a centralized billing point, generating various charges based on the type of patient (e.g., OP, IP, new, or outsider) and their eligibility criteria. The billing activities are primarily conducted through the Service Billing Advanced screen, where users can select the appropriate file type for the patient and choose the specific consultation or service for billing.

To generate a service bill, users must fill in the necessary details and click the 'Save' button. This process ensures that all billing activities are efficiently managed and recorded.

For further details, you can view the image related to the OP Billing Service Advanced [here](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png).
